About DJF

Registered on 23 May 2007, the Digambar Jain Foundation brings together Digamber Jain families living in Bangkok and welcomes Jain pilgrims and visitors from around the world.

The Jinalay

Shri 1008 Mahavir Digamber Jain Mandir in Bang Rak, with Mulnayak Shri Mahavir Ji and a hall for Swadhyay.

Community

Social gatherings, picnics and festival celebrations that keep our families connected across generations.

Learning & Service

Jain studies programmes, health camps and support for underprivileged children and the elderly.

Paryushan Parv 2026 – Highlights

Ten days of devotion, swadhyay and community at DJF Bangkok – with the committee welcoming our honoured guests, and ahaar offered at the Mandir.

Shri 1008 Mahavir Digamber Jain Mandir

Marble shrines, a golden Bhagwan Mahavir pratima and a Jain library, in the heart of Bang Rak.
